newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 5.11 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 5.11 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 5,108,400 lbs of frozen beef products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal programs.
Details of the purchase are as follows:
Total purchases since the program was announced May 17:
The latest award under Announcement LS-48, Invitation 025, will be shipped between January 13 and 26, 1997.

Winning bidders for the fine ground beef were Star Ranch (Marshalltown Iowa) 475,200 lbs, Supreme Beef Processors (Dallas TX) 1,465,200 lbs, Surlean Meat Co (San Antonio TX) 594,000 lbs, Taylor Packing Co (Wyalusing PA) 1,267,200 lbs.
Winning bidders for the VPP patties were Cherry Meat Packers (Chicago IL) 475,200 lbs, Robzens Inc (Scranton PA) 198,000 lbs, Service Packing Co (Joplin MO) 198,000 lbs.
Winning bidder for 100% beef patties was Cherry Meat Packers (Chicago IL) 356,400 lbs.
Winning bidder for the lean patties was Country Platter (Wichita KS) 79,200 lbs.
